mentions.name: Jankara-style karaoke app
mentions.description: A karaoke application built on top of Sing On Key, letting the builder sing with his wife like they did in Japan, aiming to work like the karaoke systems at Jankara.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm using it as a base to make a karaoke application so I can sing with my wife like we did in Japan. Hoping to make it similar to the systems they had set up at Jankara.
